title: Your One-Stop Solution for AI-Generated Video Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether detection models rely on spurious low-level cues by standardizing all videos to the H.264 codec and comparing detector accuracy on datasets with mixed compression formats (MPEG-4 vs. H.264) versus uniformly compressed datasets.

Mitigating sampling bias in dataset creation by categorizing prompts according to spatial and temporal attributes, applying an Attribute Balancing Selection Algorithm, and evaluating the dataset's distributional uniformity using the Penalized Global Balance Score (PGBS).
